airspace.zh: 依馬丘比丘管理單位的第002-99號決議，禁止無人機飛越這處世界遺產；遊客須知也禁止未經官方事先授權攜帶或使用無人機與類似裝置。2019年曾有遊客因在遺址上空飛無人機而被追究。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Resolution 002-99 of the Machu Picchu management unit prohibits drone flights over this World Heritage Site, and the visitor rules ban drones and similar devices without prior official authorisation. In 2019 a visitor faced proceedings for flying a drone over the ruins. Check the current rules before any real flight.

title.zh-Hant: 西班牙人沒有找到的城
title.en: The City the Spanish Never Found

tagline.zh-Hant: 約1450年的印加莊園、八十年後被遺棄、1911年的賓漢姆，到世界新七大奇蹟
tagline.en: An Inca estate of about 1450, abandoned eighty years on, Bingham in 1911 and a New Wonder of the World

zh: 馬丘比丘建在海拔兩千四百三十公尺的山脊上，
在庫斯科西北方約八十公里。
en: Machu Picchu stands on a mountain ridge 2,430 metres up,
about 80 km north-west of Cusco.

zh: 它大約建於1450年，
一般認為是印加皇帝帕查庫特克的莊園。
en: It was built around 1450
and is thought to have been an estate of the Inca emperor Pachacuti.

zh: 帕查庫特克在位於1438到1471年。
碳定年顯示，這裡約在1420到1530年間有人居住。
en: Pachacuti reigned from 1438 to 1471.
Radiocarbon dating shows the site was lived in from about 1420 to 1530.

zh: 住在這裡的大約七百五十人，
多半是服務皇室的僕役。
en: About 750 people lived here,
most of them servants of the royal household.

zh: 這座莊園只使用了大約八十年，
大約在西班牙征服的時期就被遺棄了。
en: The estate was used for only about 80 years,
and was abandoned around the time of the Spanish conquest.

zh: 許多居民，可能在西班牙人到來前就死於天花。
西班牙人始終沒有找到這裡，所以它沒有被洗劫。
en: Many of its people may have died of smallpox before the conquistadors arrived.
The Spanish never found it, so it was never plundered.

zh: 1902年，秘魯探險家利薩拉加，
在三窗之室的牆上，用木炭留下了字跡。
en: In 1902 the Peruvian explorer Agustín Lizárraga
left a charcoal inscription on the wall of the Room of the Three Windows.

zh: 1911年，當地的農民兼旅店主人阿爾特亞加說，
他知道華納比丘上有遺跡。
en: In 1911 Melchor Arteaga, a local farmer and innkeeper,
said he knew of ruins on Huayna Picchu.

zh: 7月24日，他帶著美國人賓漢姆登上馬丘比丘。
山上有一對克丘亞夫婦，正在古老的梯田上耕種。
en: On 24 July he led the American Hiram Bingham up to Machu Picchu.
At the top a Quechua couple were farming some of the old terraces.

zh: 1912年，耶魯大學與國家地理學會資助了發掘，
1914與1915年又再發掘。
en: In 1912 Yale University and the National Geographic Society sponsored excavations,
with more in 1914 and 1915.

zh: 1931年鐵路通車以後，
山下的鐵路工人營地，發展成今天的熱水鎮。
en: After the railway opened in 1931,
a railway workers' camp below grew into today's Aguas Calientes.

zh: 1981年，秘魯把這一帶劃為歷史保護區；
1983年列入世界遺產，是文化與自然的雙重遺產。
en: In 1981 Peru declared the area a historic sanctuary;
in 1983 it became a World Heritage Site, both cultural and natural.

zh: 發掘出的文物，很多被運到耶魯大學。
2010年雙方達成協議，最後一批在2012年送回秘魯。
en: Many excavated artefacts were taken to Yale.
An agreement came in 2010, and the last of them returned to Peru in 2012.

zh: 2007年，馬丘比丘入選世界新七大奇蹟。
2024年，遊客超過一百五十萬人。
en: In 2007 Machu Picchu was named one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
In 2024 it received more than 1.5 million visitors.

zh: 2011年起，遺址每天限兩千五百人；
2026年旺季每天最多五千六百人，其他時間四千五百人。
en: From 2011 the citadel was limited to 2,500 visitors a day;
in 2026 the limit is 5,600 a day in high season and 4,500 at other times.

zh: 西班牙人沒有找到的這座莊園，
五百多年後，成了全世界都想來看的地方。
en: The estate the Spanish never found
has, five centuries on, become a place the whole world wants to see.

title.en: The Sun, Holy Mountains and Stone

tagline.zh-Hant: 拴住太陽的石柱、對準昴宿星團的窗、聖山「阿普」，與不用灰漿的石牆
tagline.en: A stone that ties up the sun, a window on the Pleiades, holy mountains and walls without mortar

zh: 在印加人的信仰裡，太陽神叫做「印蒂」。
馬丘比丘有不少建築，和太陽與星空有關。
en: In Inca belief the sun god was Inti.
Several buildings at Machu Picchu are linked to the sun and the stars.

zh: 遺址分成都市區與農業區，也分成上城與下城；
神廟在上城，倉庫在下城。
en: The site is divided into urban and farming sectors, and an upper and lower town;
the temples are in the upper town, the storehouses in the lower.

zh: 因蒂瓦塔納石柱，在神聖建築群的最高處。
名字的意思，大約是「拴住太陽的地方」。
en: The Intihuatana stone stands at the highest point of the sacred complex.
Its Quechua name means roughly a place to "tie up the sun".

zh: 每年11月11日與1月30日的正午，
太陽幾乎就在石柱正上方，照不出影子。
en: At midday on 11 November and 30 January
the sun stands almost straight above the pillar, and it casts no shadow.

zh: 半圓形的太陽神殿，建在一塊巨岩上；
岩石下方的石縫，被闢成祭祀印蒂的空間。
en: The semicircular Temple of the Sun is built on a great rock;
a cleft beneath it was made into a shrine to Inti.

zh: 神殿這座塔的一扇窗，
對準十五世紀時從這裡看見的昴宿星團。
en: A window in this tower lines up with the Pleiades
as they appeared from here in the 15th century.

zh: 三窗之室的石工非常精細，
這裡也是一處觀察天象的地方。
en: The Room of the Three Windows has very fine stonework,
and was also a place for watching the sky.

zh: 遺址裡還有一塊雕成神鷹形狀的石頭，
可能是用來獻祭的石台。
en: There is also a block of stone carved into the shape of a condor,
probably a stone for sacrifices.

zh: 太陽門建在東南方的山脊上，
每年夏至，初升的太陽會從門中穿過。
en: The Sun Gate stands on the ridge to the south-east;
each year at the summer solstice the rising sun shone through it.

zh: 它也是一座要塞，
守著從首都庫斯科過來的主要入口。
en: It was also a fortress,
guarding the main approach from the capital, Cusco.

zh: 當地的克丘亞人，把馬丘比丘、華納比丘和普圖庫西山，
都看作「阿普」，也就是聖山。
en: Local Quechua people regard Machu Picchu, Huayna Picchu and Putucusi
as apus, holy mountains.

zh: 印加人把石頭看成有生命的東西。
蓋房子用的花崗岩，都在當地開採。
en: The Incas regarded stone as a living thing.
The granite for the buildings was quarried on the spot.

zh: 石塊不用灰漿，靠精準的切割緊緊相扣；
不規則的接縫，反而讓牆更能抵抗地震。
en: The blocks were fitted without mortar, cut so precisely that they lock together;
their irregular joints make the walls highly resistant to earthquakes.

zh: 遺址有十四處天然泉水，
水由十六道石砌的水道引進城裡。
en: The site had 14 natural springs,
their water led through 16 cut-stone channels.

zh: 華納比丘的意思是「年輕的山」，
印加人在山頂也蓋了神廟與梯田。
en: Huayna Picchu means "young peak";
the Incas built temples and terraces on its top.

zh: 太陽、聖山與石頭，
在這道山脊上被細心地安排在一起。
en: The sun, the holy mountains and the stone
were carefully brought together on this ridge.

title.en: Bears and Orchids in the Cloud Forest

tagline.zh-Hant: 四百二十三種蘭花、四百四十四種鳥、安地斯熊，與二十四種生態系
tagline.en: 423 orchid species, 444 bird species, Andean bears and 24 ecosystems

zh: 馬丘比丘歷史保護區，在1981年1月8日設立，
它同時保護遺址，和四周的山林。
en: The Historic Sanctuary of Machu Picchu was created on 8 January 1981
to protect both the ruins and the forested mountains around them.

zh: 這裡位在安地斯山脈的東坡，
是一片崎嶇的雲霧林。
en: It lies on the eastern slope of the Andes,
in rugged cloud forest.

zh: 保護區裡一共有二十四種生態系，
從熱帶雨林一直到高山的冰雪。
en: The sanctuary holds 24 ecosystems,
from tropical rainforest up to permanent snow.

zh: 這裡記錄到四百二十三種蘭花，
和三百三十二種樹木。
en: 423 orchid species have been recorded here,
along with 332 kinds of tree.

zh: 鳥類有四百四十四種，
包括色彩鮮豔的安地斯動冠傘鳥。
en: 444 bird species live here,
among them the brilliantly coloured Andean cock-of-the-rock.

zh: 哺乳類有七十五種，兩棲類十四種，
爬蟲類二十四種，蝴蝶多達三百七十七種。
en: There are 75 mammal species, 14 amphibians,
24 reptiles and as many as 377 butterflies.

zh: 安地斯熊，克丘亞語叫「烏庫馬里」，
是保護區裡瀕危的物種之一。
en: The Andean bear, ukumari in Quechua,
is one of the endangered species of the sanctuary.

zh: 2014到2015年，研究人員調查了三百六十八平方公里，
在超過九成五的範圍裡，都找到熊的蹤跡。
en: From 2014 to 2015 researchers surveyed 368 square kilometres
and found signs of bears in more than 95% of it.

zh: 他們找的是糞便、腳印，
還有熊啃食地上鳳梨科植物的痕跡。
en: They looked for scat and footprints,
and for signs of bears feeding on ground bromeliads.

zh: 這裡的熊，透過海拔約三千四百公尺的高山草原，
和更大的熊族群連在一起。
en: The bears here are linked to a larger population
through montane grasslands at about 3,400 metres.

zh: 研究也發現，放牧的牛
可能對熊造成威脅。
en: The study also found that grazing cattle
may pose a risk to the bears.

zh: 這裡夏天潮濕、冬天乾冷，
大部分的雨落在十月到三月。
en: Summers here are wet and humid, winters dry and frosty;
most rain falls between October and March.

zh: 一年的雨量超過一千八百公釐。
遺址的農業梯田，約有四點九公頃。
en: Annual rainfall here is over 1,800 mm.
The farming terraces of the site cover about 4.9 hectares.

zh: 烏魯班巴河往西北，
從保護區的中央流過。
en: The Urubamba River flows north-west
through the middle of the sanctuary.

zh: 遺址四周的雲霧林，
是熊、鳥與蘭花共同的家。
en: The cloud forest around the ruins
is a shared home for bears, birds and orchids.

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩座山之間的山脊、三面環繞的烏魯班巴河、兩條斷層，與印加古道
tagline.en: A ridge between two peaks, the Urubamba on three sides, two fault lines and the Inca Trail

zh: 馬丘比丘的意思是「古老的山」。
它坐落在兩座山之間的山脊上。
en: Machu Picchu means "old hill".
It sits on a ridge between two mountains.

zh: 南邊的馬丘比丘山，海拔三千零五十一公尺；
北邊的華納比丘，海拔兩千六百九十三公尺。
en: To the south Machu Picchu Mountain rises to 3,051 metres;
to the north Huayna Picchu reaches 2,693 metres.

zh: 華納比丘比遺址高出大約兩百六十公尺，
山腰較低處，有月亮神殿與大洞穴。
en: Huayna Picchu stands about 260 metres above the ruins;
lower on its flank are the Temple of the Moon and the Great Cavern.

zh: 烏魯班巴河從三面繞過這座山，
懸崖直落大約四百五十公尺到河邊。
en: The Urubamba River wraps around the site on three sides,
with cliffs dropping about 450 metres to the water.

zh: 河的東北岸，是圓圓的普圖庫西山，
在華納比丘東方約一點二公里。
en: On the north-east bank stands the rounded Putucusi,
about 1.2 km east of Huayna Picchu.

zh: 山下的熱水鎮海拔兩千零四十公尺，
名字來自鎮上的天然溫泉。
en: Aguas Calientes, below, lies at 2,040 metres;
its name, "hot waters", comes from its natural hot springs.

zh: 這個小鎮沒有公路對外連接，
只能坐火車或走路抵達。
en: The town has no road link to the outside;
it is reached by train or on foot.

zh: 從鎮上到遺址大約六公里，
走路大約要一個半小時。
en: The ruins are about 6 km from the town,
roughly a 90-minute walk.

zh: 遺址蓋在兩條斷層上，灰漿幾乎派不上用場，
所以石塊必須精準地相扣。
en: The site was built over two fault lines, which made mortar almost useless,
so the stones had to fit exactly.

zh: 牆的每一層彼此錯開，
門和窗都做成梯形。
en: The walls are offset row by row,
and the doors and windows are trapezoidal.

zh: 遺址大約有兩百棟建築，
排在梯田上，圍繞著中央的廣場。
en: Some 200 buildings
stand on terraces around a central square.

zh: 太陽門海拔約兩千七百四十五公尺，
比遺址高出大約兩百九十公尺。
en: The Sun Gate is about 2,745 metres up,
some 290 metres above the ruins.

zh: 印加古道最長約四十二點五公里，
最高點在海拔四千兩百公尺的沃米瓦努斯卡隘口。
en: The Inca Trail runs for up to about 42.5 km,
reaching 4,200 metres at the pass of Warmi Wañusqa.

zh: 古道的終點就是太陽門；
從這裡，第一次能看見整座遺址。
en: The trail ends at the Sun Gate,
the first place from which the whole site comes into view.

zh: 遺址西邊的懸崖上有一座印加橋，
建在崖壁上一段六公尺寬的缺口。
en: On the cliff west of the site is the Inca Bridge,
built where a 6-metre gap breaks the cliff.

zh: 保護區的面積約三百二十六平方公里，
遠方的山脈，有超過五千七百公尺的高峰。
en: The sanctuary covers about 326 square kilometres;
the ranges beyond hold peaks of more than 5,700 metres.
